compute_benchmark_gpu_name.description: Normalized GPU benchmark-model name used for hardware specification matching.

compute_performance_donor_model_count.description: Number of unique GPU models contributing to the same-generation performance mean.
compute_performance_donor_model_count.transform: Count of unique same-generation models with positive original per-GPU specification values used as donors.

paper_id.description: Unique focal-record identifier and join key across the core datasets.
paper_id.transform: Retained canonical corpus identifier; one row per paper_id in each core dataset.

resource_L3.transform: Frozen multi-label classification; 1 indicates public/shared-HPC access.

compute_has_missing_count_mention.description: Paper-level flag for a normalized GPU mention without a count.
compute_has_missing_count_mention.transform: True when at least one normalized GPU mention lacks a count.

compute_selected_config_id.description: Identifier of the selected normalized hardware configuration row.

compute_has_count_conflict.description: Paper-level flag for conflicting GPU-count mentions in normalized extraction records.
compute_has_count_conflict.transform: True when normalized GPU extraction records contain conflicting count mentions.

resource_L4.transform: Frozen multi-label classification; 1 indicates hosted-model/API-service access.

resource_L2.transform: Frozen multi-label classification; 1 indicates commercial-cloud access.

compute_selected_config_total_compute_ca.description: Total theoretical peak performance of the selected normalized hardware configuration.

compute_selected_per_gpu_capability.description: Per-GPU theoretical Tensor FP16/BF16 peak performance in the selected normalized configuration.
compute_selected_per_gpu_capability.transform: Specification-matched value, with same-generation supplementation when flagged; divide by 1e12 for TFLOP/s.

compute_performance_imputed.description: Flag for same-generation performance supplementation in the final selected configuration.
compute_performance_imputed.transform: True when final selected per-GPU performance uses the arithmetic mean of positive original specification values from unique GPU models in the same generation; configurations are reselected after supplementation.

compute_selected_gpu_count.description: GPU count in the selected normalized configuration.
compute_selected_gpu_count.transform: Count retained from the configuration selected by maximum count times measurable per-GPU theoretical peak performance.

compute_gpu_scale_strict_main_sample.description: Current complete, positive, configuration-aligned hardware flag, including supplemented performance values.
compute_gpu_scale_strict_main_sample.transform: True when the final selected normalized configuration has eligible positive GPU count, per-GPU performance and VRAM.

compute_performance_original_flops.description: Original per-GPU performance value retained for the final selected configuration.
compute_performance_original_flops.transform: Original specification value before generation-mean supplementation; may be missing.

venue.description: Canonical corpus conference or venue label.

year.transform: Retained canonical year; anchors the author-history and KSC windows.

compute_selected_vram_gb.description: Per-GPU VRAM capacity in the selected normalized configuration.
compute_selected_vram_gb.transform: Specification-matched VRAM value aligned to the selected GPU count and performance.

resource_L1.transform: Frozen multi-label classification; 1 indicates physical-hardware access.

api.description: Indicator of reported hosted-model/API use in the frozen resource classification.
api.transform: 1 for reported hosted-model/API use; 0 for no reported API use.

api_x_ksc.description: Interaction between API use and standardized KSC.
api_x_ksc.unit: API indicator times KSC standard deviations

api_x_memory.description: API interaction with centered per-GPU VRAM.
api_x_memory.unit: API indicator times centered resource doublings

api_x_performance.description: API interaction with centered per-GPU performance.
api_x_performance.unit: API indicator times centered resource doublings

api_x_quantity.description: API interaction with centered GPU quantity.
api_x_quantity.unit: API indicator times centered resource doublings

base_eligible_history_count.description: Eligible historical-work count in the focal topic/window before focal-work self-exclusion.
base_eligible_history_count.transform: Count eligible historical works in the same topic and [focal_year-5, focal_year-1] before subtracting an eligible focal work.

base_primary_topic_id.description: Primary Topic ID retained from the frozen integrated-data input.

citation_cumulative_from_publication_yea.description: Cumulative annual citations from the current OpenAlex publication year through 2026, including same-year citations.
citation_cumulative_from_publication_yea.transform: Sum OpenAlex counts_by_year over publication_year through 2026; absent annual counts contribute zero.

citation_current_total.description: Current total citations used for external top-cited comparisons.
citation_current_total.transform: Retained OpenAlex cited_by_count at the 2026-09-12 snapshot.

citation_metric_status.description: Citation eligibility/status label: ok, ranking_ineligible_work_type, or not_found.
citation_metric_status.transform: Frozen status; the 29,591-row input contains 29,547 ok, 42 ranking_ineligible_work_type and 2 not_found rows.

citation_openalex_primary_topic_id.description: Primary Topic ID in the citation snapshot; supplies the regression topic fixed effect.

citation_openalex_primary_topic_name.description: Primary Topic name in the citation snapshot.
citation_openalex_primary_topic_name.transform: Retained OpenAlex citation-snapshot primary_topic display name.

citation_openalex_publication_year.description: OpenAlex publication year in the citation snapshot, used for accumulation and the top-cited reference cell.
citation_openalex_publication_year.transform: Retained publication_year from the 2026-09-12 citation snapshot.

citation_openalex_type.description: OpenAlex work type in the citation snapshot.

company.description: Indicator of company participation in the focal team.
company.transform: 1 for company participation; 0 for no company participation.

eligible_historical_paper_count_after_se.description: Eligible historical-work count supporting the focal KSC value after self-exclusion.
eligible_historical_paper_count_after_se.transform: base_eligible_history_count minus one when own_h_p_subtracted is True.

eligible_impact.description: Joint baseline outcome and fixed-effect eligibility before recursive singleton removal.
eligible_impact.transform: Frozen eligibility flag; 29,547 rows are eligible.

eligible_venue_year_topic_impact.description: Joint KSC, outcome and fixed-effect eligibility before recursive singleton removal.
eligible_venue_year_topic_impact.transform: Frozen eligibility flag; 29,279 rows are eligible.

fe_topic.description: Saved KSC-input alias of the citation-snapshot topic fixed-effect label.

fe_venue_year.description: Saved KSC-input alias of the venue/year fixed-effect label.

focal_self_history_conflict.description: Flag indicating that the focal work's bibliographic year places it in its own prior-window history.
focal_self_history_conflict.transform: True when the mapped focal work occurs in the topic/window history under its bibliographic publication year.

focal_work_id.description: OpenAlex Work ID used for the focal KSC mapping.

focal_year.description: Canonical focal year anchoring the prior five-year KSC window.
focal_year.transform: Retained canonical focal year; history window is [focal_year-5, focal_year-1].

included_impact.description: Final inclusion in the baseline/API statistical sample.
included_impact.transform: eligible_impact and no recursive singleton removal; 29,487 rows are included.

included_venue_year_topic_impact.description: Final inclusion in the KSC statistical sample.
included_venue_year_topic_impact.transform: eligible_venue_year_topic_impact and no recursive singleton removal; 29,239 rows are included.

ksc.description: Equal-weighted mean historical reference-semantic span in the same focal topic during the previous five canonical years.
ksc.transform: Average eligible historical-work spans over [focal_year-5, focal_year-1] after focal-work self-exclusion; requires at least 100 eligible historical works. Historical spans use at least five usable unique references, at least 70% coverage and no future-year references.

ksc_primary_topic_id.description: Focal Primary Topic ID used for historical KSC mapping.

ksc_primary_topic_name.description: Focal Primary Topic name used for historical KSC mapping.

ksc_z.description: KSC standardized using all 29,322 available mappings in the frozen input.

log_org.description: Transformed number of organizations represented in the focal team.
log_org.unit: natural log of one plus organizations

log_team.description: Transformed number of authors in the focal team.
log_team.unit: natural log of one plus authors

mapping_status.description: Availability status of the focal historical KSC mapping.
mapping_status.transform: available for 29,322 input rows; insufficient_history for 269 rows. ksc and ksc_z are missing for insufficient_history.

memory.description: Per-GPU VRAM measure for the selected normalized configuration.
memory.transform: log2(compute_selected_vram_gb); a one-unit increase is a doubling.

memory_centered.description: Per-GPU VRAM log2 measure centered at its full 29,591-row input median.

memory_x_ksc.description: Interaction between centered per-GPU VRAM and standardized KSC.
memory_x_ksc.unit: centered resource doublings times KSC standard deviations

own_h_p.description: Focal work's reference-semantic span when available for the self-exclusion audit.
own_h_p.transform: Mean pairwise cosine distance of eligible normalized SPECTER reference vectors: 1 - (norm(sum(z_r))^2 - m) / (m * (m-1)); requires at least five usable unique references and at least 70% reference coverage.

own_h_p_subtracted.description: Flag indicating subtraction of the focal work's own eligible semantic span from its historical KSC mapping.
own_h_p_subtracted.transform: True when an eligible focal span and its row are removed from the historical sum and count.

performance.description: Per-GPU theoretical Tensor FP16/BF16 peak-performance measure for the selected configuration.
performance.transform: log2(compute_selected_per_gpu_capability); a one-unit increase is a doubling.

performance_centered.description: Per-GPU performance log2 measure centered at its full 29,591-row input median.

performance_x_ksc.description: Interaction between centered per-GPU performance and standardized KSC.
performance_x_ksc.unit: centered resource doublings times KSC standard deviations

prior_team_productivity_5y.description: Mean across team authors of log-transformed distinct eligible prior-publication counts.
prior_team_productivity_5y.unit: mean natural log of one plus prior publications
prior_team_productivity_5y.transform: For each author, count distinct eligible OpenAlex works in [year-5, year-1], take log1p(count), then average across all listed authors; eligible measurements have resolved identities and complete histories for every author. Entered directly in the regression.

quantity.description: GPU-count resource measure for the selected normalized configuration.
quantity.transform: log2(compute_selected_gpu_count); a one-unit increase is a doubling.

quantity_centered.description: GPU-count log2 measure centered at its full 29,591-row input median.

quantity_x_ksc.description: Interaction between centered GPU quantity and standardized KSC.
quantity_x_ksc.unit: centered resource doublings times KSC standard deviations

singleton_iteration_impact.description: Recursive singleton-removal iteration in the baseline fixed-effect sample.
singleton_iteration_impact.transform: Zero denotes no singleton removal; a positive integer records the iteration that removed the row.

singleton_iteration_venue_year_topic_imp.description: Recursive singleton-removal iteration in the KSC venue/year and topic fixed-effect sample.
singleton_iteration_venue_year_topic_imp.transform: Zero denotes no singleton removal; a positive integer records the iteration that removed the row.

venue_year_v14.description: Frozen combined venue/year label for the first fixed effect and covariance clustering.
venue_year_v14.transform: Frozen venue-by-year label; the fitted samples contain 69 cluster groups.

y_cumulative_citations.description: Transformed cumulative-citation outcome used in OLS.
y_cumulative_citations.unit: natural log of one plus citations

y_top1.description: Top-1-percent cited indicator relative to the external OpenAlex publication-year/Primary-Topic reference population.
y_top1.transform: 1 when citation_current_total is at least the descending ceil(0.01 * N) cutoff for core article, conference-paper and preprint records in the same publication year and primary topic; cutoff ties are included.

y_top10.description: Top-10-percent cited indicator relative to the external OpenAlex publication-year/Primary-Topic reference population.
y_top10.transform: 1 when citation_current_total is at least the descending ceil(0.10 * N) cutoff for core article, conference-paper and preprint records in the same publication year and primary topic; cutoff ties are included.

y_top5.description: Top-5-percent cited indicator relative to the external OpenAlex publication-year/Primary-Topic reference population.
y_top5.transform: 1 when citation_current_total is at least the descending ceil(0.05 * N) cutoff for core article, conference-paper and preprint records in the same publication year and primary topic; cutoff ties are included.
